recipe_note: per file: posix-relpath + LF + sha256(file bytes); lines sorted bytewise; joined with LF; sha256 of the UTF-8 encoding of that join

recipe_validation.why_note: The recipe is validated against a project whose digest was recorded by a previous build before being used to guard the two read-only projects.

assert_note: Re-assert both read_only_projects digests at the end of every stage. Any change is a §9.9 violation.
